Is your website costing you customers?

Most business owners feel these problems before they can name them. Here is what they look like to your customer.

Outdated design

A site that looks ten years old makes customers doubt your business before they read a word. We rebuild it to look current and trustworthy.

Poor mobile experience

Most of your visitors are on phones. If text is tiny or buttons are hard to tap, they leave. We design for the phone first.

Slow speed

People won’t wait for a heavy page on a mobile network. We keep pages light so they load fast, including on slower connections.

Weak credibility

No clear proof, no photos of your work, no easy way to verify you. We add the details that make a stranger feel safe contacting you.

Low enquiries

Visitors come but nobody calls. We put calls, WhatsApp and forms where people actually look, so interest turns into enquiries.

Questions business owners ask

I’m not technical. Can I still work with you?

Yes. We explain every step in plain language and handle all the technical work. You only need to tell us about your business.

How much will my website cost?

It depends on what you need. After a short call we send a written quote showing exactly what’s included.

How long does it take?

A simple business website usually takes a few weeks. Stores and custom applications take longer. You get a clear timeline before we start.

Will my website work on phones?

Yes. We design for phones first and test on real devices, because most of your customers will visit from one.

Can I update the website myself?

Yes. We set it up so you can change text, photos and offers without calling a developer. We’ll show you how.

Will people find my website on Google?

We build it so Google can read it properly and set up the basics. Rankings depend on many factors, so we don’t promise a position.

Do I own the website after it’s built?

Yes. Your domain, content and customer data belong to you.

What happens after launch?

You can choose ongoing maintenance for updates, backups, security and speed, or manage it yourself.
